installer.title: HomeFlix - Setup
installer.welcome_text:
This wizard will guide you through the installation of HomeFlix, your personal video library manager.

HomeFlix allows you to:
• Automatically organize your movies and TV shows
• Retrieve posters and metadata
• Watch your videos with resume playback
• Access your library from any device
installer.license_text:
HomeFlix is free software distributed under the MIT license.

You are free to use, copy, modify and distribute this software.

This software uses the TMDb API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDb.

installer.tmdb_api_text:
To automatically retrieve movie posters and metadata, you need a free TMDb API key.

You can add it now or later in the settings.
